description: Import a draw.io (diagrams.net) file that render_view wrote with form drawio and a user edited in draw.io: what moved, resized, folded, re-routed or recoloured, the page size, a note's text and a picture's file become DiagramLayout annotations (Layout, Route, Style, Canvas, Note, Picture) in the view's body, and a name retyped in a node, port or edge label becomes a rename of the element, declaration and references alike, applied as apply_model_edit applies its operations. Cells the rendering lacks, cells naming no element, deleted cells, a label edited beyond its name, an invalid or taken name, an emptied note and a picture source no file under the view's directory names are reported, never created, deleted or guessed. Answers the planned edits and text changes; writes the files only with apply=true.

apply.description: write the edits to disk; omitted, a dry run answering the edits and the text changes they amount to

content.description: the draw.io file's text, as render_view form drawio wrote it and draw.io saved it, compressed or not; alternative to file

file.description: the draw.io file to import, absolute or relative to the workspace root; alternative to content

inline.description: write the annotations beside the elements rather than in the view's body

path.description: the document declaring the view, absolute or relative to the workspace root

view.description: the view to import when the file has several pages; omitted, the one page's view

name: import_diagram

applied.description: whether the edits were written to disk

edits.description: edits to the document's current text, non-overlapping, in document order

newText.description: the text that replaces the range; empty deletes it

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

deleted.description: elements whose cells the file lost; nothing is deleted for them

edits.description: the DiagramLayout annotations the import plans, each from one cell

notices.description: changes the file shows that no annotation carries yet

refused.description: the planned edit the model editor refused, with why

unknown.description: cells naming no element; nothing is created for them

unmatched.description: elements the file names that the rendering lacks; their cells are not imported
